about.intro: Har photo ke andar ek chhupi hui diary hoti hai — aap kahan the, kaunsa camera use kiya, shutter dabane ka exact second. Zyadatar logon ko pata hi nahi hota. PureClear isiliye bana hai taaki koi bhi us diary ko seconds me saaf kar sake — bina kuch upload kiye, bina kisi par bharosa kiye.
about.problemTitle: Metadata dikhta nahi. Uske nateeje dikhte hain.
about.problemBody: Ek shared photo se aapke ghar ka address (GPS coordinates se), aapki daily routine (timestamps se), aur aapka mehanga gear (camera serials se) pata chal sakta hai. Journalists, activists, sellers, parents — online photo share karne wala har koi exposed hai. Aur isko fix karne wale tools ya to complicated the, ya photos kharab karte the, ya chupke se aapki files apne server par upload kar lete the.
about.p1b: Photo me chhupe GPS coordinates aapka ghar, bachche ka school, ya koi confidential meeting spot bata sakte hain — har us insaan ko jo image download kare.
about.p2b: Camera model, serial numbers aur software versions chupke se aapka gear — aur kabhi-kabhi aapko — pehchaan lete hain.
about.p3b: Timestamps aur edit history se aapki routine ban jaati hai. Aap ek pal share karte ho; ek pattern leak ho jaata hai.
about.principlesTitle: Privacy jaisi honi chahiye, waise banaya.
about.pr1t: Kuch bhi device se bahar nahi jaata
about.pr1b: Har byte aapke browser me WebAssembly se process hota hai. Bharosa karne ke liye koi server hai hi nahi, kyunki koi server involved hi nahi.
about.pr2b: No tiers, no watermarks, no 'pro' unlock. Apni files saaf karne ke paise kyun?
about.pr3b: No sign-ups, peechha karte cookies nahi, no analytics. Jo data hum dekhte hi nahi, use bech kaise sakte hain?
about.pr4b: Sirf metadata hataya jaata hai. Aapke pixels, quality aur resolution bilkul waise ke waise rehte hain.
about.ctaBody: Ek photo drop karo. Dekho andar kya chhupa hai. Ek click me saaf karo.
privacy.intro: PureClear aise design kiya gaya hai ki collect karne ko kuch hai hi nahi, store karne ko kuch nahi, breach hone ko kuch nahi. Yahan exactly likha hai kya hota hai — aur kya nahi.
privacy.imageAlt: Lock wali privacy shield se surakshit smartphone
privacy.s1t: Aapki files browser se bahar nahi jaati
privacy.s1b: Jab aap PureClear me file drop karte ho, woh poori tarah aapke device par read aur process hoti hai — browser tab me locally chalne wale WebAssembly se. Koi file, thumbnail ya metadata kisi server ko nahi bheja jaata — hamare ya kisi aur ke. Khud verify kar sakte ho: page load hone ke baad internet disconnect kar do, sab kuch phir bhi kaam karega.
privacy.s2b: Sign up karne ko kuch hai hi nahi, koi login nahi. Accounts ke bina na koi profile banegi, na email leak hoga, na password chori hoga.
privacy.s3b: Hum analytics, advertising trackers ya fingerprinting scripts nahi chalate, aur web par peechha karne wale cookies use nahi karte. Aapki visit aapka business hai.
privacy.s4b: Hum aapki processed files ka koi log nahi rakhte — na metadata, na IP se jude records. Tab band karte hi sab khatam. Jaise hona chahiye.
privacy.s5b: Imandaari zaroori hai: ek baar saaf file share karne ke baad, doosre uske saath kya karenge yeh hum control nahi kar sakte. Aur metadata hatane se chhupa data jaata hai, anonymity nahi — chehre, landmarks aur context ab bhi pehchaan sakte hain. PureClear adrishya ko hatata hai; drishya ke baare me soch-samajh kar raho.
privacy.ctaBody: Ek file drop karo aur dekho andar kya chhupa tha.
terms.title: Seedhe-sade terms, imandari se.
terms.intro: Short me: PureClear ek free tool hai jo poori tarah aapke browser me chalta hai. Yeh terms batate hain aap humse kya expect kar sakte hain, aur hum aapse kya expect karte hain.
terms.s1b: PureClear ek free, browser-based tool hai jo aapki files se metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, GPS aur aisa hi chhupa data) hatata hai. Saari processing aapke device par locally hoti hai — files humare servers par kabhi upload nahi hoti.
terms.s2b: PureClear personal aur commercial dono use ke liye free hai. Bhavishya me hum optional paid features la sakte hain, lekin core metadata removal hamesha free rahega.
terms.s3b: Aapki files ka poora ownership aapke paas rehta hai. Aisi files process na karein jinka adhikaar aapke paas nahi hai, aur PureClear ka galat kaam me istemal na karein. Apne ilake ke kanoon ka palan aapki zimmedari hai.
terms.s4b: PureClear “as is” diya jaata hai, bina kisi warranty ke. Hum metadata poori tarah aur losslessly hatane ki poori koshish karte hain, lekin har edge case ki guarantee nahi de sakte — zaroori originals ka backup hamesha rakhein.
terms.s5b: Kanoon ki anumati ki seema tak, PureClear ke istemal se hone wale kisi bhi nuksaan ke liye hum zimmedar nahi hain — data loss sahit. Hamari kul liability utni hai jitna aapne humein pay kiya (free tool ke liye, zero).
terms.s6b: Service ko disrupt karne, kamzoriyan dhoondhne, ya PureClear ko apna product batane ki koshish na karein. Sabke liye service reliable rakhne ke liye hum abusive usage block kar sakte hain.
terms.s7b: PureClear ke saath yeh terms update ho sakte hain. Zaroori badlav yahan nayi “last updated” date ke saath dikhenge. Badlav ke baad istemal jaari rakhna matlab aap inhe sweekar karte hain.
